ENEW
There's one last thing I want to mention at this school staff
meeting. ®It's about our colleague, Paulo Gardenal, who
couldn't be here today. As many of you already know,
O Paulo's not just a history teacher-he's also an author!
His first novel was published last January, and he'll
be reading a chapter from it at a community fund-raiser
tomorrow night. The event's at the Stately Hotel at eight.
